completeOriginalSourceQuestionUnchanged.individualQuestion: Preserve one target being UNABLE TO USE OR REGENERATE RP FOR1MINUTE; Core Action/120ft/1minute. Define target/save,concentration if NEW and exact start/end timing. Distinguish spending RP from gaining RP,zero-RP casts,already-paid effects,item activations and other named class resources. State whether recovery from spells,transfer,rest and regeneration is denied or deferred; do not bank missed recovery automatically or drain the existing pool when the text only forbids use/regeneration. Resolve resource-substitution abilities from their actual permissions. Recasts,suppression and expiration must not duplicate blocked transactions or retroactively invalidate lawful prior casts.

sourceRecord.completeHistoricalCommonQuestionUnchange: For every selected spell, settle all operational fields: actual activation and components, legal target/range/geometry, duration and concentration, resolution/DC/save or attack, full effect clauses, scaling, repeat casting/source identity, suppression/ending, limits and class-specific rank/cost access. Preserve printed clauses and every original source. Explicitly label NEW completions; no external-game import or automatic historical alias merge.
sourceRecord.completeHistoricalScopeExceptionUnchange: Post-push receipts are preserved only, excluded from current mechanical authoring. Existing faction/alignment/location records do not authorize new cosmology, theology or lore.

completeProposedProcedure.KEEP: One target cannot use or regenerate RP for one minute; Action120ft/V,S,F/base21. Existing RP is not drained.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_application: One perceived actual living creature, willing or not, WIS save vs8+actualPB+native casting modifier (own actual school bonuses only). Failure establishes60elapsed seconds without concentration; success no new record/no refund. No repeated save is added for this soft pool restriction. It does not impose Stunned, Action loss, Charmed or Null Veil; apply only independently applicable genuine protections.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_transactions: While operative prohibit voluntary actual RP debit costs/transfers/maintenance/sacrifices and all RP credits: innate regeneration, spell recovery, Conduit receipts, item recovery and beneficial rest gains. Other exact hostile pool destruction/drain is not a voluntary use and retains its own scope; this spell grants no generic RP theft immunity. Other resources, independent uses and rest benefits retain their sources. Known forbidden debit/credit-only declarations fail before Action/payment/use; a later actual restriction after a donor commits loses that donor principal under Conduit with0recipient credit. Recovery spells whose other targets remain legal can commit, but blocked target credit/entitlement is lost, never deferred. There is no negative pool, alternatepool or refund.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_zero_and_history: A fully final0RP ranked cast is legal if all other permissions hold. Matrix waives only its selected early buckets, so mandatory later Dampening/Burden can create positive forbidden RP. Dissonance blocks still apply at0price. No-interface charge-only/use spells keep their actual independent costs; source-specific substitutions cover only what they actually cover. An already paid Ready release, ongoing effect and a no-RP maintenance continue without a second debit; a newly due positive maintenance payment is forbidden and its own failure ending applies. Suppression permits only currently lawful new transactions; missed credit is never replayed on suppression/expiry.
